skills.name: image-deep-research
skills.description: Image deep research and visual research - use when a question is better answered by looking than by reading. Finds reference images on open, licensed collections (Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, the Art Institute of Chicago, the Met), renders real websites into screenshot contact sheets, builds a moodboard, measures a live site's palette and typefaces, and reads every picture as a picture. For design references, styles, palettes, typefaces, materials, competitors and moodboards.
headings: Render real sites - the highest-signal source
Design galleries, for finding sites worth rendering
